faults.fault: At 1.6x TALLER the extra height went almost entirely into a huge stretched dark slab of background below the cabinet: the smear/streak band a player can point at, and none of the height landed in the cabinet itself -- the bubble tubes did not lengthen and there is no taller plinth, just blank smeared panel. Blocking on both texture and meaning grounds.

On the taller prop the bubble-tube columns stay their original length while the body area below stretches with background: the extra height should have gone into longer columns and a taller plinth, not blank panel.

A hard-edged dark plane protrudes clear of the body at the upper left of the cabinet (visible in the solid render and as a stray rectangular shell in the wireframe) -- geometry floating outside the silhouette that reads as a bug, not a part.
